name: quiz-forge-smartphone
description: QUIZ FORGE portrait-first iOS smartphone version

scripts.ios:prepare: npm run web:check && cap add ios && cap sync ios
scripts.ios:build:simulator: cap sync ios && xcodebuild -workspace ios/App/App.xcworkspace -scheme App -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' build CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO
